articles.title: Trump says he is highly unlikely to order Iran strikes if talks progress
articles.description: WASHINGTON/CAIRO, Nov 8 (Reuters) - US PresidentDonald Trump on Sunday said he was highly unlikely to order fresh attacks on Iran as long as talks to end the conflict progress, even as both countries reported that shipping had been hit in or near the Strait of Hormuz."It depends on whether or not they sign a very strong agreement," Trump told CNN in a phone interview. "The answer is, highly unlikely it's going to be necessary."

articles.title: Iran suggests blasts are not US attacks as both sides report ships hit
articles.description: CAIRO, Nov 8 - Iranian media suggested explosions in southern Iran on Saturday evening were related to Iranian military activities rather than US strikes while both sides reported that shipping had been hit in or near the Strait of Hormuz. Read more at straitstimes.com.

articles.title: Iran suggests blasts are not US attacks as both sides report ships hit

articles.title: Explosions heard in Iran's Qeshm Island, Iranian media reports
articles.description: CAIRO, Nov 7 - Explosions were heard on Saturday on Iran's Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz and in the southern Iranian port of Jask, Iranian media reported, with the cause unclear. Read more at straitstimes.com.

articles.title: Two missiles strike Iran's Qeshm Island, Tasnim news agency says
articles.description: CAIRO, Nov 7 (Reuters) - Iran's semi-official Tasnim news agency said on Saturday initial reports indicated that two missiles had struck Qeshm Island, adding there was no official information on possible damage.Tasnim said further details would be released once relevant authorities confirmed the incident.The state news agency IRNA had earlier reported that local witnesses said two projectiles had struck the Suza area of Qeshm Island in southern Iran after the sound of an aircraft was heard over the island.
